{{Quote|Me? I'll be at the front, leading my people. To victory&hellip;or a glorious death.|Amand, to his advisors|<ref name="Lead by Example" />}}
'''Amand''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Molos/Legends|Molos]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], King Amand led [[Gender/Legends|his]] people in an [[Uprising on Molos/Legends|uprising on Molos]] with the support of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He, along with his palace troops, also participated in the [[Battle of Molopolis/Legends|Battle of Molopolis]] where they successfully defeated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Lead by Example" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amand appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Lead by Example]]''.
